title: Milestone windows prioritization and release notes synthesis for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Define a compact, prioritized milestone window for the upcoming combined API / Console / Runtime release train, lock scope per component, and produce a single synthesized release-notes artifact that can be consumed by GTM, support, and customers. This ticket coordinates milestone windows (canary, committed, GA), establishes cut criteria per surface (API, Console, Runtime), and defines the handoff process for release notes and comms. The aim is to reduce last-minute scope churn by making transparent tradeoffs (latency vs. features), clarifying rollback thresholds, and ensuring signals for go/no-go are automated in the release dashboard. Outcomes expected: a signed milestone cadence document, a cut-criteria checklist per component, a consolidated release-notes draft, and defined owners for any emergency rollback. This is intentionally lightweight: we want guardrails sufficient for a single train cadence without heavy process overhead.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Milestone calendar published and agreed by Engineering, DX, Reliability, and GTM owners; 2) Cut criteria checklist exists for API, Console, Runtime and is applied to each feature PR; 3) Release notes draft created and validated against the notes template with owner assigned; 4) Automated signals for canary pass/fail and customer-impact thresholds wired into the release dashboard; 5) Signoff recorded in the runbook (PM, Eng lead, SRE lead, Docs lead).
tasks: Draft milestone windows and publish to shared calendar (PM)
Run an intake review for all candidate features for this train (PM + Eng leads)
Create per-component cut criteria checklist and link to PR template (Eng)
Define canary success thresholds and wire alerts to release dashboard (SRE)
Prepare consolidated release-notes draft and circulate to Docs/GTM (Docs + PM)
Schedule cross-functional signoff meeting two business days before scope lock (PM)
Identify rollback owners and update escalation contacts in oncall rotation (SRE)
Publish final release notes and GTM comms bundle (Docs + GTM)
decisions: Adopted a single cut-date per train with component-level exceptions handled via A/B gating
Canary will be a 24-hour window with 99th percentile latency and error-rate thresholds as pass/fail signals
Release notes will be synthesized into three sections: user-facing changes, operational impact, and migration notes
